title: Early on, navigating the procedurally-generated Ashwood/Thornwold forest by cardinal directions was disorienting — many rooms looked similar and it took repeated 'get your bearings' calls to find named landmarks (Gallows Glade, the Understory, Hollow Gallery) buried several hops deep.
